messages.text:
Can you build Neon Pairs from the supplied product specification? Please implement the whole game, including its board codes, saved snapshots and replay command. Use the documented build and test commands and give me the offline dist/index.html. Keep the code arranged as the Architecture document says. If anything is unclear, ask me.

Read docs/README.md and follow its linked requirements for this project.

Built Neon Pairs and generated the self-contained offline file: [dist/index.html](/work/dist/index.html:1) (237,937 bytes). It was verified opening directly from disk with the browser offline.

The game includes deterministic board codes, snapshot import/export, the replay CLI, keyboard play, saved size and best scores, and 16×16 boards.

**Verification:** `npm ci`, `npm run typecheck`, `npm test` (18 passed), `npm run test:e2e` (8 passed), and `npm run build` succeeded. [README.md](/work/README.md:1) records the tested Node, npm, Playwright, and Chromium versions, plus that no screen reader was used.
